Control options for `est="pathfinder"` (Stan's multi-path Pathfinder)

Source: R/stanSugar.R
pathfinderControl.Rd

`pathfinderControl()` is [stanControl()] with `algorithm = "pathfinder"` forced – the same options, named after the INFERENCE ALGORITHM instead of the software tool. Because `class(pathfinderControl())` is `"pathfinderControl"`, `nlmixr2(model, data, pathfinderControl())` infers `est="pathfinder"` with no `est=` argument.

Usage

pathfinderControl(..., algorithm = c("pathfinder", "NUTS"))

Arguments

...

[stanControl()] options

algorithm

must be `"pathfinder"` (`"NUTS"` is accepted only because it is [stanControl()]'s default; an ADVI variant errors)

Value

a `pathfinderControl` list

Details

Pathfinder is implemented in this package (rstan does not expose the Pathfinder service), so it needs nothing beyond rstan; see [stanControl()] for `pathfinderPaths` and the `khat` diagnostic.

See also

[stanControl()], [nutsControl()], [adviControl()]

Author

Matthew L Fidler

Examples

ct <- pathfinderControl()
ct$algorithm
#> [1] "pathfinder"
